title: Bihar Police BPSSC ASI (Technical) 2026 Exam Postponed
vacancyDetails: 22 ASI (Technical) posts in Bihar Police Radio (Wireless); Preliminary written exam postponed from 05 August 2026
qualification: As per BPSSC ASI Technical Advt 07/2026 (technical / diploma criteria as notified)
ageLimit: 21 to 37 years for male (as on 01 Aug 2025 cut-off – confirm in advt); relaxations as per rules
selectionProcess: Preliminary Written Exam (postponed) → Further stages as per commission
documentsRequired: Registration ID; previously issued e-admit card if any; wait for revised schedule
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bpssc.bihar.gov.in
2. Open Notices → Exam Postponement PDF
3. Read ASI Technical Advt 07/2026 postponement details

shortDescription: Bihar Police BPSSC ASI Technical Exam Postponed 2026. Prelims scheduled for 05 August 2026 cancelled; new date soon at bpssc.bihar.gov.in. Admit card was out on 24 July.
content:
BPSSC has postponed the Preliminary Written Competitive Examination for ASI (Technical) under Advt. No. 07/2026.

The exam was scheduled for 05 August 2026 (Wednesday). Admit cards were released from 24 July 2026. As per the official postponement notice, the examination stands deferred with immediate effect; a new date will be issued separately.

Recruitment snapshot

  • Post: ASI Technical – Bihar Police Radio (Wireless)
  • Vacancies: 22
  • Apply period: 21 May – 21 June 2026
  • Exam status: Postponed

For candidates

  • Do not report on 05 August 2026
  • Download the postponement notice from bpssc.bihar.gov.in
  • Watch for new exam date and admit card update
